{"id":1933418345,"question_id":1800,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1772264628,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"1594 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1933418345/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Concatenation of Consecutive Binary Numbers","memory":"164.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    const int mod = 1e9 + 7;\n\n    string to_binary(int n)\n    {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        while(n > 0)\n        {\n            ans.push_back((n % 2) + '0');\n            n /= 2;\n        }\n        reverse(ans.begin(), ans.end());\n        return ans;\n    }\n    \n    int contri(string &s , long long &tsum)\n    {\n        for(int i = 0; i < s.size(); i++)\n        {\n            tsum = (tsum * 2) % mod;      \n            tsum = (tsum + (s[i] - '0')) % mod;\n        }\n        return tsum;\n    }\n\n    int concatenatedBinary(int n) {\n        long long tsum = 0;\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i <= n ; i++)\n        {\n            string binary = to_binary(i);\n            contri(binary , tsum);\n        }\n\n        return tsum % mod;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"concatenation-of-consecutive-binary-numbers","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1748}
